title: Can Emerging Markets Tilt Global Product Design? Impacts of Chinese Colorism on Hollywood Castings
eligible_reason: Single policy date (February 2012 relaxation of China's film-import quota; POST = 1[release year >= 2014]); film-level repeated cross-section with release-year FE, no unit FE; treatment is EXPOSURE x POST where EXPOSURE is a predicted China-entry probability (continuous) or its top-decile dummy (2x2). Includes film-characteristic controls X.
design_notes: Eq. (1): SHARELIGHT_i = a + b*EXPOSURE_i*POST_t(i) + Theta*X_i + lambda_t(i) + e_i. Table 5 reports b for DEXPOSURE (binary 2x2) and CEXPOSURE1/2 (continuous intensity). Table 6 is a year-interaction path (EXPOSURE x 1[year=t'], t'>=2010, 2009 omitted) used as a pre-trend/anticipation check. Table 7 matched samples, Table 8 falsification, Tables 12-14 Probit/multinomial models of China entry. Exactly one adoption date, units are films (not stable units observed over time), continuous exposure.
screener_notes: Not eligible: one adoption date, continuous exposure, no unit FE. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Data are IMDb-based films with hand-coded actor skin colour; no data-availability statement in the working-paper text (SSRN Oct 2017 version).
